swing.definition: A seat that moves forward and backward from a frame.

slide.definition: A smooth surface children slide down for fun.

seesaw.definition: A board with seats that moves up and down around a centre.

climbing-frame.definition: A structure with bars and platforms for climbing.

sandbox.definition: A shallow box or area filled with sand for playing.

monkey-bars.definition: A set of overhead bars that children swing across.

merry-go-round.definition: A circular platform that spins when children push it.

spring-rider.definition: A spring-mounted seat that rocks when ridden.

tunnel.definition: A narrow passage with an opening at both ends.

balance-beam.definition: A narrow beam used for practising balance.

ball.definition: A round object thrown, kicked, or used in games.

hoop.definition: A circular ring used for throwing or shooting a ball.

bat.definition: A wooden stick used to hit a ball.

racket.definition: A bat used to hit a ball in some sports.

net.definition: A net stretched across a court or between players.

goal.definition: A frame or net where players score points.

whistle.definition: A small object blown to make a loud signal.

stopwatch.definition: A watch that measures how long an activity takes.

helmet.definition: A hard covering worn to protect the head.

knee-pad.definition: Protective pads worn over the knees.

rubber-mat.definition: A soft surface placed under play equipment to reduce falls.

sand.definition: Small loose grains of rock or mineral material.

gravel.definition: Small pieces of stone used to cover the ground.

grass.definition: A green plant with narrow blades that covers the ground.

concrete.definition: A hard building material used for paths and surfaces.

chalk-drawing.definition: A picture or design made with chalk.

hopscotch.definition: A game where players jump through numbered squares.

painted-lines.definition: Lines painted on the ground to mark areas or games.

puddle.definition: A small pool of water left after rain.

mud.definition: Wet soft earth that sticks to shoes and feet.

child.definition: A young person who has not become an adult.

friend.definition: A person of any age who plays or spends time with you.

parent.definition: An adult who cares for a child.

teacher.definition: A person who teaches children or students.

baby.definition: A very young child who cannot yet walk well.

toddler.definition: A young child who is learning to walk and speak.

teenager.definition: A young person between childhood and adulthood.

guard.definition: An adult who watches children to keep them safe.

coach.definition: A person who trains players in a sport.

volunteer.definition: A person who freely helps without being paid.

swinging.definition: Moving back and forward on a swing.

sliding.definition: Moving down a slide for fun at a playground.

climbing.definition: Moving up or over something using hands and feet.

running.definition: Moving quickly on foot during play or exercise.

jumping.definition: Pushing off the ground and becoming airborne.

throwing.definition: Sending an object through the air with your hand.

catching.definition: Stopping and holding an object thrown toward you.

kicking.definition: Hitting a ball with your foot.

skipping.definition: Jumping over a rope as it passes under your feet.

hiding.definition: Staying out of sight so others cannot see you.

fence.definition: A barrier that surrounds a playground or area.

gate.definition: A door in a fence used for entering and leaving.

bench.definition: A long seat where people can rest.

water-fountain.definition: A public device that supplies drinking water.

shade-structure.definition: A roof or structure that provides shade.

sign.definition: A board showing rules or information.

trash-can.definition: A container that holds waste until it is removed.

first-aid-kit.definition: A small box containing materials for treating minor injuries.

bell.definition: A device that makes a ringing sound.

flag.definition: A piece of cloth attached to a pole as a symbol.
